title: Unbounded C string operation
message: Replace with size-aware operation and verify truncation/error handling.

title: C shell command sink
message: Prove command is constant or validate taint flow and replace shell parsing with direct process arguments.

title: Python dynamic code sink
message: Remove dynamic execution or prove input is trusted and fixed.

title: Python shell command sink
message: Use subprocess with fixed executable, argument list, and shell=false.

title: Python subprocess with shell=True
message: Remove shell=True; use a fixed executable with an argument list and shell=False.

title: Python object deserialization sink
message: Do not deserialize untrusted objects; use data-only format and strict schema.

title: Python YAML load without SafeLoader
message: Use yaml.safe_load or pass Loader=yaml.SafeLoader; never load untrusted YAML with the unsafe loader.

title: JavaScript dynamic code sink
message: Replace string execution with explicit parsing and dispatch.

title: Node.js shell command sink
message: Use execFile/spawn with fixed executable, argument array, and shell=false.

title: Node.js spawn with shell:true
message: Remove shell:true; use a fixed executable with an argument array.

title: PHP shell command sink
message: Use fixed executable and validated argument list without shell parsing.

title: PHP eval sink
message: Remove eval of strings; use explicit parsing and dispatch.

title: PHP object deserialization sink
message: Use JSON and strict schema for untrusted data.

title: Ruby dynamic code sink
message: Remove dynamic execution of strings.

title: Ruby shell command sink
message: Use fixed executable and separate argument array.

title: Ruby object deserialization sink
message: Use data-only format and strict schema for untrusted input.

title: Rust transmute safety boundary
message: Prove size, alignment, validity, provenance, and lifetime invariants.

title: Shell eval sink
message: Replace eval with arrays, case dispatch, or direct invocation.

title: Java process execution sink
message: Use fixed executable and validated ProcessBuilder argument list.

title: .NET process execution sink
message: Use fixed executable, ArgumentList, UseShellExecute=false, and validated arguments.

title: Go process execution boundary
message: Avoid sh -c; use fixed executable and separate validated arguments.

title: Swift process execution boundary
message: Use fixed launch path and validated argument array.
